reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI enhancement plugin providing speech input, collapsible tool-call summaries, and persistent custom CSS settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供语音输入、工具调用折叠和可持久化自定义 CSS 等交互与样式增强。
summaries.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness web interface with speech input, collapsible tool-call summaries, and persistent custom CSS settings.

capabilities: Adds browser speech-recognition input using microphone permission
Modifies the Harness web interface with custom CSS
Groups and collapses consecutive tool-call rows while preserving their details
Persists plugin settings for CSS and tool-call collapsing
